name: fly-golf
description: Can a fruit fly break 100? A simulated MaleCNS connectome plays golf.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n sim,web -c yellow,cyan "pnpm run dev:sim" "pnpm run dev:web"
scripts.test: pnpm run test:sim && pnpm run test:web
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:sim && pnpm run lint:web
scripts.lint:sim: uv --directory services/sim run ruff check . && uv --directory services/sim run ruff format --check .
scripts.lint:web: pnpm -r --if-present run lint && pnpm -r --if-present run typecheck
scripts.format: uv --directory services/sim run ruff format . && pnpm -r --if-present run format
scripts.putt: uv --directory services/sim run fly-golf putt --controller mock --seed 7
